source_note: Official train/test IDX gzip files; metrics use a deterministic per-class capped subset, not necessarily the full benchmark.
preprocessing: EMNIST orientation transpose, grayscale pixel scale [0,1], row-major flatten; user image is cropped/centered on 28x28.

algorithm.name: Manual Euclidean k-NN
algorithm.tie_break: minimum sum of neighbor distances among tied labels, then fixed character order from mapping

limitation: EMNIST labels digits and Latin uppercase/lowercase letters; Vietnamese diacritics are not included. Results on capped ByClass samples do not establish performance on real handwriting.
